name: Meat
overview: Scripture reveals that God initially provided plants and fruits for human nourishment, as stated in Genesis 1:29, but after the flood, He permitted the eating of all moving creatures for food (Genesis 9:3). The Old Testament includes specific instructions regarding clean and unclean meats, as indicated in Leviticus 11, highlighting God's holiness and order in dietary practices. In the New Testament, believers differ in their approach to eating meat, with some freely consuming all foods while others choose to abstain, focusing on personal conviction and spiritual maturity (Romans 14:2). This teaches that while meat is permissible, Christians are called to respect individual conscience and maintain unity in their dietary choices.
